name: agent-disk-guard
description: Prevents AI coding agents from filling up drive C: — intercepts file writes and shell commands via PreToolUse hooks, redirects package caches to a configurable drive (e.g. D:\AgentCache), injects environment variables, migrates existing directories with robocopy+junction, and monitors free disk space. Works with Claude Code, ZCode, DeepSeek Harness and other Claude Code-compatible agent harnesses.
